title: Scoped role assumption: AsyncLocalStorage, governed allowlist, read-time re-check
summary: Design rules for assuming roles inside a process and auditing agent-authority actions.
hint_triggers: When code needs to act under a narrower role: (1) Carry the assumed role on the AsyncLocalStorage execution scope (withExecutionContext*), never by mutating process.env — an env mirror has a LIFO race across awaits and leaks to children. (2) Precedence: in-process assumption > SYSTEM_ROLE > MISSION_ROLE > argv. (3) Bound assumptions with a governed policy file (role-assumption-policy.json): when SYSTEM_ROLE is set, only that role, its shared_core_roles, and its may_assume entries are assumable; unknown roles fail closed with [ROLE_ASSUMPTION_DENIED]; a missing/broken policy also fails closed. (4) Scopes are frozen and re-validated against the policy at every read — readers must check the scope, not a cached env. (5) For agent-authority actions (e.g. plugin view dispatch), audit dispatch + outcome on the same chain as human executions, with reasons redacted and length-capped and symmetric metadata (authority, dispatch_id, handled).
